headline: Bitcoin Stabilises Above $84,000 Amid Geopolitical Caution; Elice Rebounds 30%
summary: Bitcoin traded steadily above $84,000 as investors monitored geopolitical developments in the Middle East, while South Korean data center operator Elice surged 30% after post-IPO volatility.
why: Bitcoin's resilience at key price thresholds reflects underlying liquidity conditions and digital asset appetite during broader macro uncertainty.

impacts.name: Bitcoin
impacts.why: Geopolitical tension curbs aggressive risk-taking, keeping crypto prices range-bound above key support.
